development.says: Development run of the engine, not judged
development.from: roles.json of the engine's final set (its standing: development run of the engine, not judged), and PROGRESS.md at main a16b2571: GARD's G1, part 2, on main (17 November 2026, evening)
development.run_states: run.json states no standing of its own

model.label: GARD assembly
model.plain: A model of how heredity could begin before genes: a small assembly of molecules of many types, in which the molecules inside speed the joining and leaving of others, so that a mix of types can grow, split in two and pass something of itself on. It is a model, not an organism: it has no cell, no shape, no place and no clock of real life. The preprint Plastic Heredity uses it.

time.nominal: The clock counts fissions. The run's own time is in nominal units (its rates are per nominal time unit): a fission's nominal time is the run's.

catalysis.says: beta_ij, the world's catalysis matrix: x_i = sum_j beta_ij n_j, so a molecule of type j in the assembly speeds the joining and the leaving of type i

reservoir.says: the run's supply (rho): every type held at this concentration

rates.says: the world's derived join and leave rates, per nominal time unit

law.name: cells.gard_catalysis_pair_consistent@1
law.says: g_join_i(n) = 1 + x_i / N, on n (the state without the moving molecule); 1 when N = 0; g_leave_i(n) = 1 + (x_i - beta_ii) / (N - 1), on n - e_i (the state without the leaving molecule), when N >= 2 and n_i >= 1; 1 otherwise (the last molecule leaves uncatalysed; a type with n_i = 0 has no leave)

rules.start: the world's founder, 40 molecules of 40 types
rules.events: direct method (Gillespie 1977), one molecule per event
rules.split: exact-size multivariate-hypergeometric split, floor(N/2) to the first daughter

trace.encoding: signed type numbers, one for each molecule: +(i + 1) when type i joins, -(i + 1) when it leaves, read through the run's channel table

times.encoding: each event's place in its growth's span, from the growth's start (its birth) to its fission, as 0 to 65535: unsigned 16-bit little-endian, base64

states.says: what the run states of its law's check and of its ledger, as run.json writes it: each line is its place in run.json and the run's own text

lines.text: for a passive law the residual is rounding; for a driven law it is the unsourced cycle work, reported and never closed

law.text: Segre, Ben-Eli and Lancet (2000), PNAS 97:4112; Plastic Heredity preprint v5.0, Appendix F (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22143269)
law.licence: CC BY 4.0 (the preprint); numbers cited under D186
law.for: Appendix F, 'Common state, kinetics and environment': b_i = 1 + (beta x)_i / N; the join and leave propensities without the catalytic factor

fission.text: Plastic Heredity preprint v5.0, Appendix F, contract T2-02 (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22143269)
fission.for: exact-size multivariate-hypergeometric split, floor(N/2) to the first daughter
